lines.en: Okay. Well, I did not get the job in New York, but I got the real prize. Domestic bliss.
Jan made me breakfast this morning. Well, she bought the milk. It's soy.
This is why I do it. That's what I have to come home to.
She probably won't be up for a few hours.
This is going to be a very good year. Very good. Jan is at home. Jim is back. My protege Ryan is at corporate. Good stuff. Andy and Dwight are rocking the sales team. I feel very blessed.
